answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on a crystal beacon and files a quill-signed ocean reading each epoch; the beacon posts a fresh ocean value each epoch. Miss one, the bond decays 10 credits; seven idle epochs empty it. Auditors replay the crystal log; copied or rented readings burn the bond. First fake 35, k-th 35+6(k-1), 1,000th 6,029: 1,000 fakes cost 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 35 once, bond returned.
